secondary.title: Resale, worldwide
secondary.support: A second desk, for completed property rather than off-plan — income-producing, financeable at full LTV, and priced against what actually sold.
secondary.marketsSupport: We open a market once the licence and the inventory are both in place. Tell us which one matters to you and we will bring you what clears the filter.
secondary.filterBody: Nothing about the method changes. A resale unit runs the same filter as a launch — developer record becomes building record, supply in window becomes what else is listed, and if we cannot write the exit we do not write the entry.
secondary.registerTitle: Tell us what you are looking for
secondary.registerBody: Resale stock moves before it reaches a portal. Tell us the markets that matter to you and the desk will bring you what clears the filter.
secondary.sent: Received. {consultant} will be in touch about your markets.
secondary.note: Figures are indicative. Rental income, service charges and yields vary by unit and tenancy, and past performance in a building is not a guarantee of future return.
